title: Build a pipeline of 30 Colleges of Education and teacher-training institutes in Nigeria by Fri Nov 27
description: Colleges of Education and teacher-training programmes train the teachers who later run classes, so winning them early spreads Zedu into schools. Different from the bootcamp, university/polytechnic and K-12 lead lists. Done = 30 institutions (federal, state, private) with the public contact for ICT, e-learning or the dean of education, the programme size where public, one sentence on why Zedu fits each, and a short pitch draft for a pilot with one teaching-practice class. Public sources only, with links.
